spans.s: f. Direction, injunction, laying down; सर्बास्वेब वैकृतीषु देशनासु प्राकृतं धर्मजातमपेक्ष्यते वाक्यशेषत्वेन । [[ŚB. on
[दिश्-णिच् युच्] Direction, instruction.

[दिश्-अच्] 
__1 A place or spot in general; देशः को नु जलावसेकशिथिलः [[

]] (often used after words like कपोल, स्कन्ध, अंस, नितम्ब &c., without any meaning; स्कन्धदेशे [[Ś. 1. 19]] ‘on the shoulder’). 
__2 A region, country, province, land, territory; यं देशं श्रयते तमेव कुरुते बाहुप्रतापार्जितम् [[

.]] 
__3 A department, part, side, portion (as of a whole); as in एकदेश, एकदेशीय q. v. 
__4 An institute, an ordinance. 
__5 Range, compass; दृष्टिदेशः [[
Pt. 2

.]] 
-Comp. 
-अटनम् roaming through a country, travelling. 
-अतिथिः a foreigner. 
-अन्तरम् 
__1 another country, foreign parts; [[

.]] 
__2 longitude. 
-अन्तरिन् m. a foreigner. 
-आचारः, -धर्मः a local law or custom, the usage or custom of any country; देशधर्मान् जातिधर्मान् कुलधर्मांश्च शाश्वतान् [[

.]] 
-कण्टकः a public calamity. 
-कारी N. of a Rāgiṇī. 
-कालौ m. (du.) time and place; न देशकालौ हि यथार्थधर्माववेक्षते कामरतिर्मनुष्यः [[

.]] 
(-लम्) ind. according to time and place; सत्पात्रं महती श्रद्धा देशकालं यथोचितम् [[

.]] 
-कालज्ञ a. knowing the proper place and time. 
-च्युतिः banishment or flight from one's country. 
-ज, -जात a. 
__1 native, indigenous. 
__2 produced in the right country. 
__3 genuine, of genuine descent. 
-दृष्ट a. 
__1 seen in a country. 
__2 customary in a place; [[

.]] 
-भाषा the dialect of a country; आलोच्य लक्ष्यमधिगम्य च देशभाषाः [[
Kāvyāl. 4. 35

.]] 
-रूपम् propriety, fitness; [[
Mb. 12

.]] 
-विद्ध a. properly perforated (pearl); [[Kau.

.]] 
-वृत्तम् a circle depending upon its relative position to the place of the observer. 
-व्यवहारः a local usage, custom of the country.

[दिश्-कर्तरि ण्वुल्] 
__1 A ruler, governor. 
__2 An instructor, a preceptor. 
__3 A guide in general. 
__4 A shower. 
__5 An indicator. 
-Comp. 
-पटुम् a mushroom.
a. [देशे प्रसितः ठन्] Local, pertaining to a particular place, native, अदेशिका महारण्ये ग्रीष्मे शत्रुवशं गताः [[

.]] 
-कः 
__1 A spiritual teacher (गुरुः) धर्माणां देशिकः साक्षात् स भविष्यति धर्मभाक् [[Mb.]] 
__2 A traveller. 
__3 A guide 
__4 One familiar with places.

a. 
__1 Told, directed, ordered. 
__2 Advised, instructed. 
__3 Pointed out, shown, indicated.
__1 The fore-finger; वत्स मा रोदीरितीन्द्रो देशिनीमदात् [[

.]] 
__2 an index, contents.
__1 The dialect of a country, one of the varieties of the Prākṛta dialect; see [[

.]] 
__2 N. of a Rāgiṇī. 
-Comp. 
-कट्टरिः a kind of dance. 
-नाममाला N. of a dictionary of provincialism by Hemachandra.

a. [देशे भवः -छ] 
__1 Belonging to a province, provincial. 
__2 Native, local. 
__3 Inhabiting any country (at the end of comp.); as in मगधदेशीय, तद्देशीय, वङ्गदेशीय &c. 
__4 Not far or distant from, almost, bordering on (used as affix at the end of words); अष्टादशवर्षदेशीयां कन्यां ददर्श [[
]]; ‘a girl about 18 years old (whose age bordered on 18); षङ्वर्षदेशीयमपि प्रभुत्वात् प्रैक्षन्त पौराः पितृगौरवेण [[
]]; so पटुदेशीय &c.

a. [दिश्-कर्मणि ण्यत् देश-यत् वा] 
__1 To be pointed out or proved. 
__2 Local, provincial. 
__3 Born in a country, native. 
__4 Genuine, of genuine descent. 
__5 Being on the spot or place (where anything is due). 
__6 Not far from, almost; see देशीय above. 
-श्यः 
__1 An eyewitness of anything अभियोक्ता दिशेद्देश्यम् [[

-53.]] 
__2 The inhabitant of a country. 
-श्यम् The statement of a question or argument, the thing to be proved or substantiated (पूर्वपक्ष).
a. To be pointed, shown or declared.
A pointer, an indicator; तेषां कुपथादेष्टॄणां पततां तमसि ह्यधः [[
Ved. A gift.

a. 
__1 Very liberal. 
__2 Intractable, unruly. -m. A washerman.
